entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit customer support, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling because I'd like to return a VeloBand Pulse I bought last month. I just haven't used it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is there a technical fault with the device, or is it more of a personal preference?

Oh, no, it's not broken or anything. I just... I feel really bad about it, but I haven't even taken it out of the box. I thought I'd be using it every day, but I just can't. I could really use that money back right now.
I understand. Do you have the order number handy so I can pull up the details?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order here for the VeloBand Pulse. It looks like it was delivered to you back on December 15th.
That sounds about right. So, can I send it back?
I've reviewed the purchase date, and I'm afraid it's now too late to process a return for this item. Our return policy for the VeloBand Pulse is ten days from the date of delivery.

Only ten days? Oh, no. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for so long, I bought my first bike from you years ago. I was hoping for a little flexibility. The holidays were so busy, it just completely slipped my mind. Are you sure there's nothing you can do?

I do see your long history with us, and I appreciate your loyalty. However, the return window on this specific product is strict. Because it's a wearable electronic device that's in close contact with the skin, for safety and hygiene reasons, we cannot accept it back after the 10-day period has passed.
But it's not even opened. It's just sitting here. Doesn't that make a difference?

I wish it did, but unfortunately, our policy is based on the time since delivery, not the condition of the box. It's a matter of sanitation protocols that we have to apply consistently for all customers. I'm very sorry, but my system is locked and won't allow me to generate a return label for this order.
Wow. I just... I really feel foolish for spending that money now. I was counting on getting it back. I thought VeloFit would be more understanding.

I truly am sorry for the disappointing news. While a return to us isn't an option, many of our customers who find themselves in a similar situation have had good success selling unopened products on the official VeloFit Resale Marketplace forum. You could likely recover most of the cost there.
I guess that's my only choice then. Okay. Thank you for your time, David.
You're welcome. I apologize again that I couldn't provide the resolution you were hoping for today. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
